# Tidewater Goods

> Tidewater Goods sells organic cotton percale and linen bedding online in the United States.

## Products

- [Percale sheets](https://tidewater-goods.example/percale): Organic cotton percale, 300 thread count.
- [Linen sheets](https://tidewater-goods.example/linen): Belgian flax linen sheet sets.

## Company

- [About](https://tidewater-goods.example/about): Founded in 2019 in Charleston, South Carolina.
